description: One sealed code pairing worked through by sealed_box.py. The device sends device_public_key_b64 in pair/start. On confirm the server makes secret_b64 and a one-time X25519 key pair (server_private_key_b64, fixed here, random in use), takes shared = X25519(server_private, device_public), derives key = HKDF-SHA256(ikm = shared, salt = 'wrist-assistant-pair-v1', info = watch_id as UTF-8, 32 bytes), and seals the 32 raw secret bytes with AES-256-GCM, associated data 'pair_secret'. /v2/pair/status answers reply with state 'confirmed'; box is the ciphertext followed by the 16 byte tag. All base64 is standard with padding. The device opens it with X25519(device_private, server_public), which gives the same shared secret.
